categories.main_business_segments: Yue Yuen Industrial operates primarily in two segments: footwear manufacturing and retailing of sportswear and footwear products. The manufacturing segment produces athletic/outdoor shoes, casual shoes, sports sandals, soles, and components for leading international brands. The retail segment, operated through its subsidiary Pou Sheng, manages a large integrated sportswear retail network in the Greater China region.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes smart technology-based footwear manufacturing, incorporating digital lean management, intelligent automation, and eco-intelligent manufacturing systems. It integrates SAP ERP and One Common Platform (OCP) across factories to optimize production efficiency and agility. The Group also pilots AI agents to enhance digital innovation and operational capabilities, focusing on sustainable materials and process engineering.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yue Yuen serves major international footwear brands including Nike, adidas, Asics, New Balance, and Salomon. Its retail business targets consumers in the Greater China region through Pou Sheng’s extensive store network and omni-channel platforms. The company’s products cater to athletic, outdoor, casual, and sports sandal markets globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group’s manufacturing operations are primarily located in Indonesia (54% of shipments), Vietnam (31%), and mainland China (11%), with additional facilities in Cambodia, Bangladesh, Myanmar, and India (under development). Retail operations focus on the Greater China region, including mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. The company also serves global markets through its brand customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yue Yuen operates mainly as an upstream and midstream player in the footwear supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying finished footwear products and components to international brands. It also operates downstream retail through Pou Sheng, providing an integrated platform for distribution and sales in Greater China.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic priorities include advancing smart manufacturing through digital transformation, AI integration, and eco-intelligent production. It focuses on shortening lead times, enhancing production flexibility, and embedding sustainability in operations. Retail strategy emphasizes omni-channel development, digital capabilities, and operational efficiency. R&D investments support innovation in product development, sustainable materials, and process improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through manufacturing orders from international brand customers and retail sales via Pou Sheng. Manufacturing revenue comes from product sales of footwear and components, while retail revenue includes sales of shoes, apparel, commissions from concessionaire sales, and related services. The company also earns income from leasing commercial spaces in retail operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yue Yuen is the world’s largest manufacturer of athletic and casual footwear, competing with other global footwear manufacturers and suppliers. It holds a leading market position due to its scale, diversified production footprint, strong relationships with top international brands, and integrated retail presence in Greater China. Competitors include other major footwear manufacturers and sportswear retailers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yue Yuen reported revenue of approximately US$8.18 billion, a 3.7% increase from 2023, with footwear shipment volumes rising 16.9% to 255.3 million pairs. Profit attributable to owners increased 42.8% to US$392.4 million. The company maintains a strong financial position with net cash of US$185.9 million and a gearing ratio of 15.4%. Capital expenditure was US$211.3 million, supporting capacity expansion and digital transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yue Yuen offers best-in-class innovative footwear manufacturing solutions with a focus on quality, flexibility, and sustainability. Its multinational production footprint provides strategic supply chain diversification for brand customers. The Group’s integration of smart technology, digital transformation, and ESG-centric management differentiates it by enabling agile, efficient, and eco-friendly production. Its retail subsidiary enhances customer engagement through omni-channel presence and digital innovation.
